book.name: Huan
book.title: Ka Maroyow No Nangnangonon No Insulat Ni Huan Bahin Ki Hisu Kristu

content: Ka Kasal dio to Kana
Ka igkatatolu no allow duon ka kasal dio to lunsud to Kana no sakup to Galilia. Duon dio ka inoy ni Hisus no nig-amut to kasalan.
Songo nigtugunan si Hisus mgo hibatoon din dio to kasalan no nig-amut dan on.
Ko warad on ka inumanon
dan, nigkagi to inoy ni Hisus ki Hisus. Kagi rin, “Warad on ka inumanon dan; noubus on!”
Kagi ni Hisus to inoy rin “Manio, Ino, to og-insaan a nu? Kono pad no allow ku to ogtuman ka bantaan to Magboboot koddi kai to soi kalibutan.”
Kagi to inoy rin kuwo to mgo suguonon, “Tumana now ka agad nokoy no igsugu din,” kagi to inoy rin.

Duon dio to sikan no baloy ka hon-om no kuron no nohimu to batu. Kara sagboka no kuron, ogkasoloran to marani to songo gatus no litru no woig. Duon ka mgo kuron dio su ka batasan dut Balaod to mgo Hudiu to malasi ogpanhugas.
Insugu ni Hisus ka mgo suguonon to, “Hiponaa now ka mgo kuron to woig.” Nò, pinasimil dan ka woig.
Kagi ni Hisus kuwo kandan, “Sakuga now; ihatod now dio to igbuyag to mgo suguanon to mangasawa.” Inhatod dan on dio to kandin

no pigtimtiman din ka sika woig no nabawi on no inumanon. Waro mataga ka sika igbuyag to suguonon to mangasawa ko hondoi mogligkat ka inumanon. Nataga atag ka mgo suguanon no nigsakug. Nò, pig-umawan to sika igbuyag ka sika ogpangasawa

no kagi rin kuwo kandin, “Ka tahan no batasan to mgo otow, igpohun-a ran ka maroyow no inumanon. Ko dakol ka pog-inum to mgo magaliug, no konad on ogkananaman ka pog-inum dan, ian igpoinum ka mad-ang on. Di sikoykow, atag, noindanan nud ka maroyow no inumanon no kuntoon on igpoinum to mgo otow ka maroyow.”

Ko nigbalig ni Hisus ka sikan no woig no nohimu to inumanon dio to lunsud to Kana no sakup to Galilia, sikan ian ka an-anayan no igkabolongbolong no pighimu rin. Nigpapitow on si Hisus to kabogbogan din. Nò, nohogot on ka pogtuu to mgo hibatoon din kandin.
Ko naponga on, nanhondio si Hisus, ka inoy rin, mgo hari rin woy ka mgo hibatoon din to lunsud to Kapirnaum no pila ro no allow ran dio.
Ka Pogdogil ni Hisus to mgo Ogbaligya dio to Dakol no Ampuanan
Nighondio si Hisus to Hirusalim su magaan on ka pagkoonan to mgo Hudiu no oghingaranan to Pagkoonan to Paligad.
Ko nokouma on, nighondio to Dakol no Ampuanan to mgo Hudiu. Dio din kitaa ka mgo otow no ogbaligya to baka, mgo karniru, mgo salapati.
Duon dod ka mgo ogsaliu to kalkalasi no salapi no ogpinpinnuu duon to lamisaan dan no masalsaliuoy to salapi.

Nò, nighimu ni Hisus ka lubid no lalamposoy no sikan ian ka indogil din to mgo baka, mgo karniru dio to libuwasan. Agad nigbalintuad din ka mgo lamisaan to mgo ogsalsaliu to salapi no nakasawod on ka salapi dan.
Nò, nigsugu din ka mgo ogbaligya to salapati no duon to kulungan to, “Awaa now soini tibo. Ko now himua ka baloy to Amoy ku to palingki now.”

To nigdinog ka mgo hibatoon din, nigdoromdom dan ka inkasulat to Tahan no Kasulatan no impasulat to Magboboot bahin ki Hisus. Kagi “Kai ro ian moubus ka goinawa ku, Magboboot, to soini no baloy nu no nalogdog kai to goinawa ku no unawa to hapuy.”
Nig-inso ka mgo Hudiu ki Hisus, “hondoi ka pighimu nu no kabolbolonganan no igpatuu to duon katondanan nu to oghimu to soini?”
Nigtabak si Hisus to maralom no kagi. Kagi rin, “Ko oggulakon now ka soin no baloy to Magboboot, oghimu a oghutuk to tatolu ro no allow.”
Kagi to mgo Hudiu, “Umba bag ian sikoykow nò! Kahop-atan no tuid woy hon-om ka poghimu noy to soin no Dakol no Ampuanan. No sikoykow atag, tatolu ro bag no allow ka poghimu nu oghutuk? Ka ku kow!”
Di ka lituk to kagi ni Hisus atag, ian ka lawa rin no ogkamatoy di ogkootawan to igkatatolu no allow.
Nò, ko nootawan on si Hisus, pigdoromdom to mgo hibatoon din to soin no innangon din. Nò, nigtuuan on ka impasulat to Magboboot dut Tahan no Kasulatan woy ka kagi ni Hisus.
Nataga si Hisus ka Duon dio to Goinawa to mgo Otow
To dio pad to Hirusalim to Pagkoonan to Paligad si Hisus, mohon-ing no mgo otow no nigtuu kandin su nigkita ran ka mgo koin-inuan din no impakita rin kandan.
Di si Hisus atag, wa din pad mogsalig to sikan no mgo otow su natagaan din on ka batasan to tibo no mgo otow.
Wa din awosa to ognangonan sikandin to batasan to mgo otow su agad waro ognangon kandin, natagaan din ka duon to goinawa ran.

footnotes.text: Ka inumanon to mgo Hudiu ian ka woig to ubas no kono pad ogporos.
Litos to mgo Hudiu no igtubad dio to Magboboot ka mgo soini.
Ian oyow sagboka ro ka kalasi no salapi to tibo no mgo otow.
